recognize_zh: 紅血球之間有一大團由許多單顆血小板緊密聚集、邊緣不規則、中央帶紫色顆粒的團塊，旁邊是一顆單核球，典型的血小板凝集（可導致假性血小板低下）。
features: Large irregular aggregate of numerous individual platelets with purple granulomeres and pale hyalomeres
Aggregate is anucleate with ragged, feathery margins
Adjacent monocyte with folded nucleus and gray vacuolated cytoplasm
A lymphocyte and a smudged cell at the upper left
Erythrocytes largely normocytic without significant poikilocytosis
describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows a large aggregate of platelets composed of many discrete granular platelets without a nucleus, adjacent to a monocyte. Red cells are unremarkable in this field. Platelet clumping of this kind can falsely lower the automated platelet count (pseudothrombocytopenia, often EDTA-dependent); correlation with a citrate-anticoagulated sample or a smear review is recommended.

ddx.vs: True thrombocytopenia shows few platelets without aggregates on the smear, whereas clumps indicate an artifactually low analyzer count.
In satellitism platelets rim neutrophils individually rather than forming free aggregates.
Stain precipitate is refractile and lacks hyalomere/granulomere structure; organisms are uniform in size and shape.
